hero.headline: The 2025 Competitive Edge: Design Velocity That Outpaces Your Market
hero.subhead: While your competitors wait 5-7 days for design revisions, you'll ship campaigns the same week. We're building a cohort of 10 companies who treat design as competitive advantage.

problems.title: Slow Kills Momentum
problems.description: Your competitor launched their Q1 campaign last week. You're still waiting on design revisions. By the time you launch, they've captured mindshare.

problems.title: Inconsistent Looks Amateur
problems.description: Freelancer A does your social posts. Freelancer B handles presentations. Agency C owns the website. Your brand looks like 3 different companies. Enterprise clients notice.

problems.title: Expensive = Rationed
problems.description: At £150 per social post, you test one ad instead of five. You skip updating that old pitch deck. You make do with 'good enough' because 'great' costs too much. Your competitors aren't rationing.

problems.title: Hiring Creates New Bottlenecks
problems.description: Hire a designer for £45K/year. They're great at brand work, weak at motion graphics. They get sick. They take holiday. They quit after 8 months. You're back to square one.

timelineStages.title: The Realization
timelineStages.description: You finally update that pitch deck you've been putting off for 6 months. You test 3 ad variations instead of 1. You request 5 social post designs 'just to see what works.' For the first time, you realize: you've been rationing design for years.

timelineStages.title: The Shift
timelineStages.description: Your marketing team stops saying 'we can't launch until design is ready.' They start saying 'let's test that—we can have 3 versions by Thursday.' Campaign velocity increases 3x. Not because you're working harder. Because design isn't the bottleneck anymore.

timelineStages.title: The Perception Gap
timelineStages.description: Competitors start asking who your agency is. Prospects comment on your 'brand consistency.' You're the same size as your competitors, but you look 3x bigger. This matters when you're pitching enterprise clients. They don't buy from companies that look scrappy.

timelineStages.title: The Unfair Advantage
timelineStages.description: You can't imagine going back. While other companies your size spend 2 weeks getting a freelancer's attention, you ship campaigns the same week. Your competitors are still stuck in 2024's design constraints. You've moved on.

benefits.title: Speed & Agility
benefits.description: Test more. Iterate faster. Capture opportunities while competitors are still briefing freelancers. Same-week delivery on every request—respond this week, not next month.
included: Same-day delivery available for urgent requests

benefits.title: Strategic Partnership

benefits.title: Institutional Knowledge

cohortReasons.title: Cohort Economics
cohortReasons.description: 10 companies at £999/month = predictable revenue that lets us invest in your success, not chase new clients. You get consistency and focus. We get sustainability.
cohortReasons.tradeOff: We turn away companies that don't fit. You get a design partner incentivized for long-term relationships.

cohortReasons.description: Monthly strategy calls where we know your business. A design team that understands your market position and competitive landscape. Not possible if we're servicing 50 clients.
cohortReasons.tradeOff: You don't get instant 24/7 availability. You do get designers who know your brand without needing re-briefs.

cohortReasons.title: Anonymous Cohort Insights
cohortReasons.description: You're in a cohort with 9 other growth-stage companies. We share patterns we see across the group. Example: 'We're seeing 3 B2B SaaS companies get better results with benefit-led ad copy. Worth testing?'
cohortReasons.tradeOff: We can't disclose who else is in the cohort. You do get strategic intelligence from companies at your stage.

faqs.question: What's included in Class of 2025?
faqs.answer:
Five strategic capabilities:

1. Campaign Velocity - Unlimited requests, most completed within 48 hours
2. Market Agility - Same-week delivery guaranteed, no rush fees
3. Strategic Partnership - Monthly 1-hour strategy sessions with cohort insights
4. Institutional Knowledge - Dedicated team that learns your brand deeply
5. Rate Lock - £999/month through December 31, 2026

Plus: Brand asset management, style guide development, unlimited revisions, and everything your brand needs for consistency at scale.

faqs.question: How is this different from your standard service?
faqs.answer:
Three material differences:

1. Turnaround - Class of 2025: Same-week guaranteed. Standard: 3-5 days.

2. Strategic Access - Class of 2025: Monthly strategy calls, cohort insights, priority for new capabilities. Standard: Execution-focused.

3. Pricing - Class of 2025: £999/month locked through 2026. Standard: £1,449/month.

Both get unlimited design and dedicated teams. Class of 2025 gets faster turnaround and strategic partnership.

faqs.question: What happens after December 31, 2026?
faqs.answer:
Three options:

Option 1: Continue at £999/month (most clients choose this)
Nothing changes. Keep the strategic partnership.

Option 2: Renegotiate based on usage
If your needs grew significantly or decreased, we can adjust.

Option 3: Part ways
30 days notice. No penalties. Your rate lock is preserved if you return.

New clients after signup: £1,449/month minimum, no rate lock.

faqs.question: Can I pause or cancel?
faqs.answer:
Complete flexibility:

Pause: Anytime with 30 days notice. Your rate is preserved. Resume whenever ready.

Cancel: Anytime with 30 days notice. No penalties. Keep all the work.

Rate Lock: If you pause or cancel, your locked rate is reserved. Return in 2027? Still at your founding rate.

Compare to agencies (3-6 month contracts), freelancers (lost relationships), or hiring (can't pause employees).

faqs.question: How do monthly strategy sessions work?
faqs.answer:
1-hour calls, scheduled monthly, focused on visual strategy:

- What's working across the cohort (anonymous insights)
- How your design supports business goals
- Campaign planning for upcoming quarters
- Visual trends relevant to your market

Not possible with freelancers (transactional) or large agencies (account manager layer blocks access). You get direct access to the team working on your brand.

faqs.question: What's your turnaround time?
faqs.answer:
Same-week delivery guaranteed. Most projects completed within 48 hours.

Breakdown by complexity:
- Social posts, email templates: 24-36 hours
- Presentations, landing pages: 36-48 hours
- Multi-page documents: 48-72 hours
- Full brand guides: 5-7 days

Urgent requests: Many completed same-day. Just flag it.

We track this religiously. Q4 2024 average was 36 hours.

faqs.question: How is this different from hiring a designer?
faqs.answer:
Three key differences:

1. Capacity - One designer: 15-20 assets/month. Our team: 30-50+ assets/month.

2. Specialization - One designer: Great at brand, weak at motion graphics. Our team: Full spectrum.

3. Risk - Hire for £45K/year, they leave in 8 months, start over. With us: Institutional knowledge stays, cancel anytime.

Trade-off: You don't get someone in your office. You do get more capacity, broader skills, zero turnover risk.

faqs.question: Why lock in now vs waiting for Class of 2026?
faqs.answer:
Let's be honest about trade-offs:

Lock in now:
- £999/month through December 2026 (14 months)
- Continue at £999 after OR renegotiate
- £6,300 savings vs standard rate
- Join inaugural cohort from day one

Wait for Class of 2026:
- Opens mid-2026 at earliest (if we run it)
- Entry price likely £1,200-1,500
- Shorter lock-in period
- Start 6-12 months behind companies building momentum

Waiting costs £450-900/month from January 2026 forward. That's £5,400-10,800 over one year.

Locking in makes sense if you're serious about market positioning in 2025-2026.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faqs.answer:
No. Month-to-month subscription.

Cancel with 30 days notice anytime. No penalties. No questions.

The "commitment" is:
- £999/month while active
- 30 days notice to cancel

No 6-month minimum. No annual contracts. No cancellation fees.

Your rate lock is the benefit, not a trap. We can't raise your price. You can cancel anytime.

faqs.question: What types of design work do you handle?
faqs.answer:
Everything your brand needs for consistency across touchpoints:

Digital: Social graphics, email templates, landing pages, display ads, motion graphics

Sales: Pitch decks, presentations, proposals, case studies, one-pagers

Brand: Logo development, brand guidelines, template libraries, icon sets

Print: Brochures, business cards, event graphics, packaging

What we don't do: Video production (we do motion graphics, not editing), photography (we do editing), website development (we do design, you handle code), 3D modeling.

faqs.question: How do I submit requests?
faqs.answer:
Three ways:

1. Slack (most popular) - Dedicated channel, real-time updates
2. Email - Dedicated project email, 2-hour response
3. Trello/Asana - Integrate with your existing tools

Each request includes:
- What you need
- When you need it
- Reference materials
- Any constraints

We'll ask clarifying questions if needed, then get to work.

faqs.question: What if I have multiple brands?
faqs.answer:
One active request per brand at a time.

2 brands = 2 simultaneous requests for £999/month.

5+ brands = Consider Enterprise tier for that volume.

Most Class of 2025 companies have 1-2 brands.

faqs.question: How do you maintain quality with unlimited requests?
faqs.answer:
Three mechanisms:

1. Focus - One request at a time per brand. Deep focus until it's done right.

2. Consistency - Same designers work on your brand every time. Quality improves as they learn.

3. Unlimited revisions - We don't stop until it's right. No revision limits.

Our incentive: Keep you subscribed long-term. That only happens if quality stays high.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with the work?
faqs.answer:
Unlimited revisions until you're satisfied.

Process:
1. Provide specific feedback
2. We revise and deliver updated version
3. Repeat until you're happy
4. No limit on revision rounds

First month: If genuinely unsatisfied, cancel within 30 days. You're only out £999 and keep all work.

What we need: Specific feedback. "The colors feel too corporate" gives us direction. "I don't like it" doesn't help us improve.
